svg.title: The Systemverse — systems connected through governed data
svg.desc: Sixteen system capability groups connect through an integration fabric to master data management and a common data model. Data and Knowledge includes analytics and organizational knowledge. Manufacturing and OT includes shop-floor controls.
svg.text: The systems that support how your business works.
Applications and machines connected through shared, governed data.
Sixteen capability groups. The systems and connections are unique to the business.
